title: ecoLogicStudio Miami Bio-Computational Design Hub
role: Proposed building brief for Living Morphologies. Occupancy figures are unverified architectural planning assumptions, not ecoLogicStudio's actual staff or event capacity, and not a calculated building-performance assessment.

plan.note: The studio site is about 270,600 square feet, 330 by 820 feet. It is not the county property area and it is not the imported parcel ring.

intention: Proposed work-leisure integration for the Miami hub: interdisciplinary collaboration, adaptable shared spaces, public engagement, controlled laboratory access, and a continuous relationship with Biscayne Bay.
